reason: The framework decomposes utterances into emotion, logic and behavior elements, applies LLM reasoning and gated multi-view MIL for cognitive-distortion classification. Evaluation on Korean and English mental-health datasets measures classification quality. It is a task-specific LLM application, not inference efficiency or compression; the linked MiniLM paper is unrelated technically.
title: Multi-View Attention Multiple-Instance Learning Enhanced by LLM Reasoning for Cognitive Distortion Detection
